description: ACT-SEL-02, deciding variant: candidate stability when index leaves split. Sl (index on k) and Sl2 (no index) are filled with 4096 rows (n, n) from NUM; on each UPDATE SET k = k + 100000 WHERE k >= 0 and then UPDATE SET k = k - 1 WHERE k > 100 run with dbFailOnError; RecordsAffected, then Count(*), Min(k), Max(k) and the number of rows with k above 100000. Follow-up probe (status F) for ACT-SEL-02; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-fold through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE Sl (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Sl PRIMARY KEY, k LONG)
CREATE INDEX IX_Sl_K ON Sl (k)
INSERT INTO Sl (ID, k) SELECT n, n FROM NUM ORDER BY n
DROP TABLE RqNoSuchMarker
UPDATE Sl SET k = k + 100000 WHERE k >= 0
DROP TABLE RqNoSuchMarker
SELECT Count(*) AS n, Min(k) AS lo, Max(k) AS hi, Sum(IIf(k > 100000, 1, 0)) AS above FROM Sl
DROP TABLE RqNoSuchMarker
UPDATE Sl SET k = k - 1 WHERE k > 100
DROP TABLE RqNoSuchMarker
SELECT Count(*) AS n, Min(k) AS lo, Max(k) AS hi, Sum(IIf(k > 100000, 1, 0)) AS above FROM Sl
CREATE TABLE Sl2 (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Sl2 PRIMARY KEY, k LONG)
INSERT INTO Sl2 (ID, k) SELECT n, n FROM NUM ORDER BY n
